The Moon is wandering through Sagittarius all day.

The Moon spends the whole day in Sagittarius, with no major aspects to hurry her, while Mercury and Venus are retrograde. Swipe for Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Earth friend. 🌙

#earthsigns #taurus #virgo #capricorn #moonjournal
